Enhance your tobacciana collection or gift an enthusiast with this visually striking, conversation-starting set. Both pieces are pre-owned and sold as shown.

282095829.description: This lot includes 9 natural mineral specimens primarily composed of selenite, a crystalline form of gypsum. The pieces range in translucency from translucent to transparent and exhibit a pearly luster. Most specimens are colorless or white, with one showing a light tan hue. The crystals display characteristic striated and bladed formations and are in raw, unpolished condition with some natural edge chipping. These selenite specimens are suitable for mineral collectors, metaphysical applications, or educational purposes.
